messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PAGER fired -> PDINC-8421: high queue backlog on scale-controller (service: inference-gateway). Threshold exceeded: backlog > 8k for 5m. Auto-escalate enabled. :rotating_light:
pd-bot: PDINC-8421 acknowledged by sara-nguyen at 2026-03-14T10:12:02Z :white_check_mark:
sara-nguyen: I'm on it. seeing 20k queued requests on /v1/generate, p50 latency jumping. any quick wins to relieve pressure?
mike-ortega: autoscaler logs show repeated "failed to provision nodes: quotaExceeded" over last 7m. trying manual scale, but cloud quota rejects.
sara-nguyen: ugh. can we route traffic to region-us-west-2 warm pool?
cheng-liu: partially yes, traffic split rule exists but warm pool is already warm; however downstream model serving nodes are saturated. we can temporarily reduce concurrency per worker to free CPU but will increase RT. ok to trade latency for progress?
sara-nguyen: do it. lower concurrency from 8 -> 2 on the critical pool. mike, please run the command.
mike-ortega: running now:
```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-worker-critical --replicas=20
# then lower concurrency envvar
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/inference-worker-critical MAX_CONCURRENCY=2
```
cheng-liu: applied concurrency change to critical pool, restarting pods. workers are restarting; expect short spike in errors during bootstrap.
incident-bot: Incident timeline: backlog 20,312 -> applying mitigations (concurrency reduction, manual scale) -> awaiting provisioning confirmations.
sara-nguyen: provisioning attempts failing b/c cloud project quota for cpus in region is at limit. ops-lead, can you allow temporary quota increase?
ops-lead: on it; reaching out to cloud support immediately. ETA 8-12m for approval. Meanwhile, can we shed non-critical traffic?
mike-ortega: I can flip a routing rule to deprioritize embeddings and rerank routes for free-tier customers. that'll free about 30% of tokens. anyone object?
sara-nguyen: do it. update status page afterwards.
status-bot: Drafting status update: "We are experiencing increased backlog for text-generation requests in us-east-1. We are throttling non-essential routes and performing manual scaling. Some requests may see increased latency or transient errors. Engineers are investigating." Approve? :pencil:
cheng-liu: approve. add estimated impact: ~15% of requests delayed, errors for a small subset of heavy batch jobs.
pd-bot: PDINC-8421 escalated to secondary on-call: cheng-liu (5m since ack).
sara-nguyen: cloud support responded: quota increase can be expedited to 100 CPUs in us-east-1 if we accept rate-limited provisioning (staged). ops-lead please confirm.
ops-lead: confirm. accept staged provisioning. mike, initiate manual capacity replacement in eu-west-1 to take overflow while us-east scales.
mike-ortega: provisioning eu-west spill cluster: creating ephemeral dedicated pool and diverting 20% of new requests to eu-west edge LB. running rollout: `apply traffic-split rule`.
sara-nguyen: monitoring metrics: backlog falling from 20k -> 11k after concurrency change and routing. p95 latency still high (1.8s -> 3.6s). errors 502 spike at restart windows.
cheng-liu: observed KV-cache thrash on model v2 when workers were restarted, causing extra tokens to regen. disabling KV prefetch for restart window to reduce regen.
mike-ortega: disabled KV prefetch flag on the restart cohort. logs show reduced repeated context uploads. backlog now 6.2k.
sara-nguyen: good. open question: why did autoscaler fail to provision? controller logs show stuck reconcile with error: `nodegroup creation timeout` and `rate limited by cloud provider`. file snippet:
```
I0314 10:08:27.123 ReconcileNodeGroup error: create nodegroup failed: quotaExceeded
I0314 10:09:05.987 ReconcileNodeGroup error: create nodegroup failed: rateLimitExceeded
I0314 10:10:11.452 ReconcileNodeGroup retrying
```
cheng-liu: looks like rate limiting + quotas combined with a quick surge caused controller to back off. we'll add better failure classification and fast-path for manual override.
sara-nguyen: action items now: 1) ops-lead to confirm staged quota (in progress), 2) mike to keep rerouting noncritical traffic and bring eu-west pool up, 3) cheng to open a follow-up task to harden autoscaler behavior + alerting, 4) sara to coordinate customer comms. follow-up doc id: INF-ops-2026-013 (will create).
ops-lead: staged quota approved by cloud support; they will provision in waves over next 10m.
status-bot: Posting status update to status.redwoodinfra.com: "Mitigation: non-essential routes throttled; spillover traffic diverted to eu-west; manual scaling and concurrency reductions applied. We expect steady recovery in 10-20 minutes. Impact: increased latency for some text-generation requests and transient 502s for heavy batch loads."
customer-note: @support-team please mark high-touch customers with high throughput and notify them if they have open SLOs impacted.
sara-nguyen: PDINC-8421 moving to monitor state. keeping thread open for verification. thanks all. :heart:
pd-bot: PDINC-8421 resolved by sara-nguyen at 2026-03-14T10:46:29Z.
cheng-liu: follow-up: creating RFC for autoscaler hardening: - backoff jitter cap, - explicit quota-check before node group creation, - emergency manual-provision endpoint for oncall. I'll assign and link to INF-ops-2026-013.
mike-ortega: note: we saw one customer job lost due to pod eviction during restart. support will reach out.
sara-nguyen: closing thread in 30m if metrics remain stable. final metrics snapshot before closing: backlog 450, p95 latency 1.1s, errors trending <0.5%.
incident-bot: Thread closed by sara-nguyen at 2026-03-14T11:06:29Z (after 54m).
__notes: Generated Slack thread about autoscaler capacity exhaustion, manual mitigation, routing changes, and customer comms. Single-thread string per agents.md rules.
